verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the solution page. It positions Document AI for compliance-first organizations with secure on-premises deployment and points to a public Trust Center. Self-hosting implies the customer controls data residency and retention, but no documented retention settings, deletion APIs or zero-retention options appear for the hosted service. Missing for 10: documented retention-period controls, file/document deletion API, zero-data-retention option for the hosted API, Trust Center retention policy details, independent corroboration.
